/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json
calls=[]
for line in open('counterparty-c2a-gate3-r27.jsonl'):
    try: d=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    if not isinstance(d,dict): continue
    m=d.get('message')
    if not isinstance(m,dict): continue
    c=m.get('content')
    if isinstance(c,list):
        for b in c:
            if isinstance(b,dict) and b.get('type')=='tool_use':
                calls.append(b)
for i,b in enumerate(calls):
    s=json.dumps(b['input'])
    print(i,b['name'],len(s),s[:140].replace('\\n',' | '))
EOF
